title: Version Locker + Profiles Glance: pin-by-environment and perf-preview UX
creator: Marco Diaz
description: Design and build a compact console workflow called 'Version Locker' paired with a 'Profiles Glance' panel. Goals: let platform users pin a model version per environment (dev/staging/prod), pin by traffic % or 100% lock, preview performance profile implications, and surface compatibility/fallback rules before committing. Deliverables: new UX in Model -> Deployments to configure pin targets, a performance-preview modal that shows latency/cost/quality delta vs current active variant, and an audit trail entry for pin actions.
acceptance_criteria: Users can select a model and choose a pinned version scoped to an environment (dev|staging|prod)
Pin modal supports: 100% lock, gradual rollout by percent (eg. 10%, 50%), and a checkbox to enable automatic fallback to a compatible variant when pinned model is unavailable
Profiles Glance shows: median latency, 95th latency, tokens/sec, per-token cost estimate, and an inferred quality delta compared to current active version
Preview modal estimates cost impact for expected QPS and shows a small chart of expected latency distribution
Audit log records: actor, timestamp, previous pin state, new pin state, and link to perf snapshot used for decision
notes: Design decision: prefer environment-scoped pinning over global pin to reduce blast radius for customers that use multiple lanes
Trade-off considered: exposing too many rollout knobs increases cognitive load; kept percent rollout simple with presets (10%, 25%, 50%, 100%) and an advanced numeric input
We opted not to surface model internals (quantization details) in the initial version of Profiles Glance to avoid overloading non-ML users; this will be an opt-in advanced tab
Engineering asked to include a compatibility check that tests model signature (input schema, function-calling contract) before allowing a pin to 100%
design_feedback: DES-review (2026-02-12) by Aisha Patel: make the perf-preview chart single-dimension by default (latency) with an inline toggle for cost/quality to keep the card compact
DES-iteration (2026-02-17): mockups updated to include a small heatmap showing per-sequence-length latency impact; moved rollout presets below the percent input
PM note: ensure color palette accessible (WCAG AA) for heatmap; DES updated tokens to accessible colors 2/24
engineering_notes: ENG-sync (2026-02-14) with runtime team: we need an API endpoint that returns perf profile deltas between two model versions for a given sequence length distribution
ENG-impl guidance: perf previews should be generated from sampled historical traffic (last 24h) and simulated for each candidate model variant using cached microbenchmarks
Implementation plan: backend changes tracked in ENG-2345, PR linked below; frontend will reuse existing Rollout component with small extensions for percent presets
